paragraph.shortAbout: Today, FOOD CITY center is a large center with 100 types of shopping and services, including all kinds of specialized food, consumer goods, beauty, household goods, clothing, many national dishes, fast food, car sales, training, maintenance, children's toys, and salons. and working.
paragraph.aboutTitle: FOOD CITY SHOPPING CENTER IS A COMPLETE SHOPPING AND SERVICE CENTER TO STORAGE AND SELL ALL KINDS OF FOOD, FOOD PRODUCTS, RAW MATERIALS AND FOOD SUPPLIES FROM ONE PLACE.
paragraph.about1: The construction of the FOOD CITY modern complex shopping center or mall with an area of ​​30,000 m2, was started in 2018 to introduce new standards in the field of trade and services of Mongolia, to provide services that meet international standards, and to increase employment. It was fully operational in 2021. Nowadays, FOOD CITY mall is a large shopping center with many types of shopping and services, including variety of food, consumer goods, beauty, salons, manicure, pharmacy, household goods, clothes, coffee shops, bakery, convenient store, food court, fast food restaurants, hot pot restaurant, sports bar, indoor playground, toys, auto sales, services and maintenance. BUKHBAT LLC has opened and invested in HAPPY LAND playground, FAT POT hot pot franchise restaurant, BAR 23 sports bar, and FOOD CITY MEAT butchery at its FOOD CITY mall and continues to expand its business activities.
paragraph.entertainmentPara1: HAPPY LAND indoor playground that can accommodate a total of 200 children, and aged 1-10 can play in here. Let your beloved child play in a safe and comfortable environment.

meat.title: “FOOD CITY” MALL MEAT SHOPPING AREA
meat.p1: 1. There is a room for meat receiving, shredding, sorting and packaging.
meat.p2: 2. There is a cellar for deep freezing cold storage of meat. /300 tons of meat /
meat.p3: 3.It has an accredited food laboratory for testing meat and meat products.
meat.p4: 4. Each trading floor is connected to hot and cold fresh water, waste water and oil holding systems.
meat.p5: 5. Ion lights are installed in the sales area and cold storage to remove bacteria.
meat.p6: 6. The building's main ventilation, cooling, camera, communication and fire systems are connected to the shopping mall.

sportBar.p1: Dear sports fans, if you want to spend time with your friends, loved ones, and colleagues in a fun, comfortable place, we present to you the BAR 23 sports bar located in 1st floor of Food City shopping mall.
sportBar.location: Location: 1st Floor of Food City shopping mall.

fatpot.text1: “FAT POT” hot pot restaurant is the official franchise of Chinese “Shouxing” hot pot restaurant in Mongolia , which is famous for its health soup. Unlike ordinary hot pot soup, FAT POT is characterized by the presence of healthy ingredients and medicinal herbs.
fatpot.text2: A team led by a professional chef prepares seven types of soups including bone broth, tomato soup, pepper soup, spicy soup and mushroom soup with healthy ingredients. It has a sober and comfortable hall with a capacity of 188 customers and seven VIP rooms.
